description: Read a search or a next page started by find_trends: state queued or searching, succeeded with result and warnings, or failed with error.code and error.message. wait_seconds (at most 50) holds the answer until the search finishes or the wait ends; an unfinished answer carries retry_after_seconds and poll. sort reorders the reels. display_markdown is a ready table; display_hint says how to show it. untrusted_content lists the third-party text fields. credits_charged is the price once succeeded. Free.
name: get_trend_search
title: Get a trend search
